```artifact
Feature: Alarms System Testing

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm
    Given the average leakage over X seconds is greater than 3 L/min
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be high priority

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm
    Given the system detects an involuntary shutdown
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be a continuous-tone alarm
    And the alarm should emit a sound tone for at least 2 minutes

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm
    Given the AC mains power is lost
    When the GUI detects the loss
    Then the "AC mains power loss" alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be medium priority

  Scenario Outline: High Leakage Alarm with Boundary Values
    Given the average leakage over X seconds is <leakage>
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm should be <expected_state>
    And the alarm should be <expected_priority>

    Examples:
      | leakage | expected_state | expected_priority |
      | 2.5     | inactive       | n/a               |
      | 3.0     | inactive       | n/a               |
      | 3.1     | active         | high              |
      | 4.0     | active         | high              |

  Scenario Outline: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm with Boundary Values
    Given the system detects an involuntary shutdown
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should be <expected_state>
    And the alarm should be a continuous-tone alarm
    And the alarm should emit a sound tone for at least 2 minutes

    Examples:
      | expected_state |
      | inactive       |
      | active         |

  Scenario Outline: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm with Boundary Values
    Given the AC mains power is <power_state>
    When the GUI detects the loss
    Then the "AC mains power loss" alarm should be <expected_state>
    And the alarm should be medium priority

    Examples:
      | power_state | expected_state |
      | connected   | inactive       |
      | disconnected| active         |
```
